visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a gym environment with professional fitness racks and weight plates visible in the background. The man performs a series of sleight-of-hand magic tricks, tearing the paper and transforming it into a clear plastic bottle of water, then seemingly merging the bottle back into the paper. The woman reacts with exaggerated, playful expressions and gestures, including pointing and pulling at her top to emphasize her reaction. The lighting is bright and even across the scene. (2) The scene transitions to a static shot where the man and woman stand side-by-side. The man holds a large white promotional poster for the 'TRE Taipei International Adult Exhibition' with red and black text and logos. The woman speaks directly to the camera with high energy, gesturing frequently with her hands and pointing towards the poster to highlight the event details. On-screen text subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom, mirroring her spoken dialogue. In the final moments, a pink text box appears at the top right, displaying a promotional discount code while the woman continues to wave playfully.
